description: This Power BI visual leverages the powerful Cognite Data Fusion 3D library, Reveal, to seamlessly embed and interact with complex 3D models of industrial assets within your Power BI reports and dashboards. By connecting directly to your CDF instance, this visual allows you to navigate the model, zoom, pan, and select components for detailed inspection. Users can visually correlate their Power BI data with the physical context of their assets by exploring the 3D representation. This enables a richer understanding of spatial relationships within industrial environments and complements other Power BI visuals for comprehensive data analysis. In order use this visual, and valid subscription to Cognite Data Fusion is required. Contact Cognite at https://www.cognite.com for more details.
